<sense>
<definition> (פָּגַם; cmp. פְּגִימָה) 
<italic>semicircular turret, niche in a city wall;</italic> also 
<italic>independent turret open on one side</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. V, 1 how do you define city limits (v. עָבַר)? בית … פ' נכנס פ' יוצא if (in a row of joined dwellings) one house stands outside the line and one inside, one turret (of the wall) is projected and one recedes. Ib. 55
<sup>a</sup> היה בית אחד יוצא כמין פ' if one house projects in the way of a turret (in a semicircle). Y. ib. V, 22
<sup>b</sup> bot. [read:] מן גו פ' measuring from the inside of the turret. Ib. נותנין פ' לפ' we may allow an outer turret to a turret, i.e. we count the city limits from a turret which serves as a defence to a turret; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּגוּמִים</plural-form>. Erub. l. c.—Ch. פִּיגְמָא.—V. פְּגִימִין.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes> Ḥull. 17

<sup>a</sup> וכמה פ' המזבח and how large is the indentation which unfits the altar?; v. חָגַר II; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּגִימוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. 17
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>concavity of an arch, crescent</italic>, &c. R. Hash. 23
<sup>b</sup> (expl. לפני החמה ib.</definition>
<notes> II, 6) פְּגִימָתָהּ לפני החמה וכ' was the concave side of the crescent directed towards the sun or away from the sun? Ib. מעולם … פגימתה של לבנה ולא פגימתה של קשת the sun never faces the concave of the crescent or the concave of a rainbow; Y. ib. II, 58
<sup>a</sup> פִּיגְמָתָהּ; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>violation</italic> (
<italic>of virginity</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Snh. 73
<sup>b</sup> במקפדת על פגימתה וכ' Ms. M. (ed. פִּיגְמָהּ) when she is excited over her violation, and says &c.—[Y. Sabb. VI, 8
<sup>a</sup> bot. פגימה, read: פְּגוּמָה, v. פָּגַם.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q00068">
<head-word>פָּגַל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. פָּגַם) 
<italic>to mutilate; to make rejectable, loathsome; to unfit</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Denom. פִּגּוּל.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פִּיגֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of פִּגּוּל) 
<italic>to make a sacrifice rejectable through improper mental disposal</italic> (Lev. XIX, 7); 
<italic>to be the cause of becoming piggul</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. 13
<sup>b</sup> טבילת אצבע מְפַגֶּלֶת בחטאת the act of dipping the finger in the blood of the sin-offering (with an inappropriate mental disposal, e.g. with the intention of offering the limbs the next day) unfits the sacrifice. Men. II, 3 התודה מפגלת את … אינו מְפַגֵּל את התודה an inappropriate intention connected with the thank-offering unfits also the bread (that goes with the thank-offering), but an inappropriate intention with regard to the bread does not affect the thank-offering. Ib. הכבשים מְפַגְּלִין וכ' improper intentions connected with the offering of the lambs affect &c. Ib. 13
<sup>b</sup> אין מתיר מפגל את המתיר one act which fits the sacrifice for eating (v. מַתִּיר) cannot unfit another act of the same nature, e.g. if the priest on offering a handful of flour had in mind an unlawful application of the frankincense, the latter is not hereby made rejectable. Ib. עד שיְפַגֵּל בשתיהן וכ' until he had in his mind an improper application of both of them to the extent of the size of an olive. Ib. 17
<sup>a</sup> הקטרה מפגלת הקטרה one offering burnt on the altar (if connected with an improper intention) may cause the unfitness of another offering. Ib. אין מפגלין בחצי מתיר you cannot create 
<italic>piggul</italic> with one portion of the 
<italic>mattir</italic> (s. supra); a. fr.—Part. pass. מְפוּגָּל; f. מְפוּגֶּלֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְפוּגָּלִים, מְפוּגָּלִין; מְפוּגָּלוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. II, 3, sq. Tosef. ib. V, 5; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְפַּגֵּל, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְפַּגֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be made rejectable, to become</italic> פִּגּוּל.</definition>
<notes> Men. 13
<sup>b</sup> פיגל בירך … לא נ' של שמאל if he had an improper intention with regard to the right side of the offering, the left did not become 
<italic>piggul</italic> (the priest eating thereof is not guilty). Zeb. 28
<sup>b</sup> מה שלמים מפגלין ומִתְפַּגְּלִין וכ' as in the peace-offerings there are parts which create 
<italic>piggul</italic> (e.g. the sprinkling of the blood with a wrong intention concerning the limbs or the flesh) and again parts liable to become 
<italic>piggul</italic>, so in all things liable to become 
<italic>piggul</italic>, there must be parts which make, and parts which become 
<italic>piggul</italic>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>

<notes> Num. R. s. 21 כל הפּוֹגֵם את עצמו פיגם וכ' he who tarnishes his reputation discredits his family at the same time; Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 2; Yalk. Num. 772. Y. Snh. II, 20

<sup>b</sup>, v. אַכְסְנַאי. Gen. R. s. 6 חוזר ופוגם אותה (not אותם) the text reduces her (the moon) again (calling her ‘the small light’). Pes. 105
<sup>b</sup> טעמו פְּגָמוֹ as soon as he tasted it (the wine in the cup), he rendered it unfit (for a cup of benediction); a. fr.—Part. pass. פָּגוּם; f. פְּגוּמָה &c. Sifré Deut. 320 בזוי ופ' contemptible and detested (Yeb. 63

<sup>b</sup> בעל פ' if he had connection with an impaired woman (opp. שלימה). Y. Sabb. VI, 8
<sup>a</sup> bot. כדי שלא … פ' (not פגימה) that it should not appear as if the right shoe were defective; a. e.—Esp. (law) 
<italic>to impair the legal value of a document by admitting a receipt on account</italic> (cmp. שׁוֹבֵר). Keth. IX, 7 הפּוֹגֶמֶת כתובתה a woman that impairs her marriage contract. expl. ib. 8. Ib. 87
<sup>b</sup> פוגמת כתובתה בעדים if she states that she has received partial payment in the presence of witnesses. Ib. פוחתת … היינו פוגמת if a woman lessens the amount in her marriage contract (declaring that it has been made out for a larger amount than had been agreed upon) …, is it the same as admitting partial payment or not? Y. ib. IX, 33
<sup>b</sup> יורש שפ' אביו שטר חובו an heir whose father had admitted partial payment on a note of indebtedness in his possession; Tosef. Shebu. VI, 5. Gitt. 18
<sup>a</sup> עד שתִּפְגּוֹם וכ', v. זָקַף; Y. Shebi. IX, beg. 39
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="Q00076">
<head-word>פְּגָם</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>injury, deterioration; blemish, discredit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vayishl. 5 פ' הוא לאשה it is discreditable to a woman (to be showy). Y. B. Kam. VIII, end, 6
<sup>c</sup>; Bab. ib. 93
<sup>a</sup> משום פְּגַם משפחה because it is a discredit to the entire family. Gitt. 59
<sup>b</sup> משום פְּגָמוֹ של ראשון because it might cast a reflection on his predecessor (making it appear as if he were not a legitimate priest); משום פ' שניהם because it reflects on both of them. Sot. 41
<sup>a</sup> משום פגמו של ראשון because it discredits the scroll first used (as if it had been found unfit for reading in it). Sifré Num. 92 דברי פ' criticising words, opp. דברי שבח. Yalk. Ps. 846 ע"א קרויה לשם פְּגָמָהּ וכ' a heathen deity is named with an opprobrious epithet, as 
<italic>ḥerem, shekets</italic> &c., opp. לשם שבח; a. fr.—נותן טעם לפ', v. טַעַם. Cant. R. to VII, 8 (in Chald. dict.) אנן בעינן נתן ביה פ' וכ' we desire to discredit him (the idol), by being there and not bowing to him &c.—Snh. 73
<sup>b</sup> פִּיגְמָהּ (from פֶּגֶם), v. פְּגִימָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>indemnity for deterioration</italic> in value or social standing, to be paid to a seduced or outraged girl.</definition>
<notes> Keth. III, 4 המפתה נותן בושת ופ' וקנס the seducer must pay an indemnity for exposure to shame and for loss of value, and a fine besides. Ib. 7 פ' רואין אותה וכ' as to indemnity for loss of value, we estimate her as if she were a handmaid to be sold &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="Q00060">פְּגִימָה</xref>) 
<italic>the decrease of the moon</italic>; trnsf. 
<italic>decline</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 15 (ref. to Ps. LXXXIX, 38) כהדין סיהרא … אתם מונין לפְגָמוֹ like the moon: if you do good, you shall count by its fulness (by referring to your political ascendancy); if not, you shall count by its decrease (by the symptoms of decline); Pesik. Haḥod., p. 53
<sup>a</sup> לפְגָמָהּ; v. next w.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>

<entry id="Q00236">
<head-word>פּוֹלְמוֹס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (πόλεμος) 
<italic>war</italic>, esp. 
<italic>war with the Romans</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. IX, 14 בפ' של אספסיינוס during the Vespasian war; בפ' של טיטוס during the Titus war; בפ' האחרון during the last war (Hadrianic revolution); Tosef. ib. XV, 8 (missing in ed. Zuck.). Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39
<sup>c</sup> top עד מתי אנו הורגין בפ' וכ' how long yet shall we slay one another in war?; a. fr.—[Tosef. Ḥull. III (IV), 27, read: פֵּילָמוֹס, v. אפונס.]—
<plural-form>Pl. פּוֹלמוֹסָיוֹת, פּוּלְמְסָאוֹת, פּוּלְמְסָיוֹת</plural-form>. Par. VIII, 9 (מים) המכזבים בפ' waters which are known to have failed in wars. Y. Erub. I, end, 19
<sup>d</sup> הרוגי פל' slain in battle (during a revolution). Y. Yoma V, 42
<sup>d</sup> bot. Lam. R. to II, 2 כמה פ' עשה וכ' how many wars did Hadrian wage?; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
